data.DescribeText: On the night of 28 October 1746 a great earthquake and tsunami shattered the port of Callao; by 1750 the viceroyalty still rebuilds cathedrals and warehouses.
data.StoryText: On the night of 28 October 1746, a great earthquake and tsunami shattered the port of Callao and leveled much of Lima. By 1750 the viceroyalty still rebuilds cathedrals and warehouses; tribute mules still pick through the rubble of the audiencia. Confirm the reconstruction tax, dispatch the silver fleet, and seat a new cabildo before the king's auditors arrive.
data.CharacterText: Viceroy Teodoro de Croix, Manuel de Amat, Bishop of Lima
data.SuccessText: The viceroyalty restores its capital and the silver fleet sails.
data.FailText: The viceroyalty loses revenue and royal favor in the same season.

data.DescribeText: The Bourbon reforms arrive in Lima by way of Madrid. The viceroy is instructed to streamline the audiencias.
data.StoryText: The Bourbon reforms arrive in Lima by way of Madrid. The viceroy is instructed to streamline the audiencias, abolish certain corregidores, and reserve the Potosí silver mint for crown account. The creole elites of the audiencia oppose the visita; the highland caciques eye the change in labor drafts. Choose the shape of the reform or face a slow provincial rising.
data.CharacterText: Viceroy Teodoro de Croix, Jose de Armendariz, Manuel de Amat
data.CountryText: Viceroyalty of Peru, Crown of Castile
data.SuccessText: The Bourbon reforms are seated and the treasury recovers.
data.FailText: Reform stalls and the creoles grow restless in the audiencia.

data.DescribeText: Quebec Winter Crisis
data.StoryText: The long winter of 1754-1755 breaks the supply lines from Montreal. Provisions run thin in Quebec and Trois-Rivières. The intendant petitions Versailles for relief convoys.
